traps: Superior/inferior PALPEBRA = eyelids; palpebral FISSURE = the opening; COMMISSURE = the junction (canthus).
Palpebral conjunctiva lines lids (incl. both surfaces of the third eyelid); bulbar conjunctiva covers the sclera; the fornix is the reflection between.
Orbicularis oculi (facial nerve) CLOSES the lids; levator palpebrae superioris (oculomotor nerve) ELEVATES the upper lid.
Parotid duct → vestibule at the upper 4th premolar · zygomatic ducts → beside the last upper molar · mandibular + major sublingual ducts → sublingual caruncle.
Mechanical papillae: filiform (multi-pointed, body + apex) vs conical (single-pointed, root). Taste: fungiform, foliate, vallate.
Nasolacrimal duct opens in the rostral VENTRAL nasal meatus.
Pharynx: nasopharynx (dorsal to soft palate) → oropharynx (caudal to palatoglossal arches) → laryngopharynx (dorsal to larynx).
